憲.source: Digital Daijisen けん【憲】; complete JMdict entries 1158900, 1257580, 1257590, 1551630
憲.coverage: Fundamental rules, constitution, and regulation/official senses distinguished. Selected ケン is supported by the actual 憲法 article and Joyo row.
憲.restrictions: 憲法's けんぼう is obsolete; 立憲 also has an abbreviated party-name sense. Daijisen's のり is supplementary kun evidence, not merely a name reading.
憲.comparisons: Law/rule/standard pairs use 法 律 規 則 制 典 準; regulatory or official pairs use 官 公 監 督. Public/official adjective versus officeholder is an English-label distinction, not unrestricted substitution.
憲.notPromoted: 察 and 警 occur in policing vocabulary, but observation or warning alone is not the same as a fundamental law or regulation.

監.source: Digital Daijisen かん【監】, cross-reference けん and noun げん; complete JMdict entries 1213610, 1213680, 1213720, 1590860, 2580300
監.coverage: Watching/regulating, supervisory roles, prison, and separately qualified historical administrative uses. Full 監査 family also contains 鑑査.
監.restrictions: ケン is explicitly Go-on in Daijisen despite only appearing as nanori in the pinned KANJIDIC2 record. げん has two archaic JMdict senses. Exact 監物 has no matching JMdict family; its reading is supported by the actual Daijisen character entry, not invented from a compound alignment.
監.comparisons: Direct watching, guarding, inspection, control, office/role and historical district comparisons are kept separate; actual titles and complete bodies were inspected. After the first exposure run, 血 白 工 were also read completely; the proposed Starter-safe choices are 白 人 小, not the earlier 皿 塩 乱.
監.notPromoted: 房 is a room, 禁 prohibits, and 臣 is a retainer/subject: sharing a prison compound, an institution or a component does not alone make these direct synonyms. 政 concerns political affairs rather than every supervisory office.

督.source: Digital Daijisen とく【督】; complete JMdict entries 1213720, 1401750, 1455390, 1455400 and the three supplementary families
督.coverage: Supervision, command/leadership and urging for timely action. Actual 監督 article supports トク; overall job-title meanings are not mechanically allocated to each character.
督.restrictions: 總督 is search-only in the 総督 family. 基督 is rare ateji, usually kana, with Portuguese source Cristo; it supplies no general スト reading for 督. Daijisen's かみ is supplementary, not selected.
督.comparisons: Command and leadership include 将 率 長 主 and existing command/control cards. 催's prompting sense and 責める's independently checked second sense support urging pairs. Request/demand and English direct comparisons are qualified.
督.notPromoted: 指's finger/pointing, 急's urgency or hurrying, 注's directed attention and 方's direction/method are not made synonyms merely from an English stem, a related activity or a shared compound.
